trust_decision.summary: Two decisions: (1) in plugin-file-manager, whether a storage record's admin-supplied `path`/`options.documentRoot` may resolve outside a trusted root before multer writes an uploaded file there; (2) in core/server, whether a plugin name may be an arbitrary filesystem path that PluginManager.require()s as a module.

landing_point.why: The summary says arbitrary file write; the write destination is computed here as path.join(getDocumentRoot(storage), storage.path) with no containment check, and both operands come from the admin-editable `storages` record (path field at src/common/collections/storages.ts:55-61, options.documentRoot at :43-48).

POST /api/storages:create and POST /api/storages:update (documentRoot + path validation helper)
POST /api/attachments:create and POST /api/attachments:update with a non-multipart body carrying values.path/values.filename

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A plugin name is an admin-supplied package identifier on the pm API/CLI, not a file path, and the advisory is about the upload write; the file-manager already bounds attachment paths with resolveSafePath, so the plugin include can be argued to be a separate, trusted-admin feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An already-trusted absolute local documentRoot (LOCAL_STORAGE_DEST or an existing storages row pointing at a mounted volume outside <cwd>/storage) must stay fully usable; runs at the same sink as the poisoned value. Over-broad fixes (reject every absolute documentRoot, or allow only <cwd>/storage/uploads) break legitimate deployments.

storage.path using Windows backslash separators (windows\path) -> normalised to windows/path
storage.path with a leading slash (/abs) -> stripped to a relative segment
storage.path with traversal segments (../outside) in create, update, and at the write destination
options.documentRoot submitted by the request (validated against allowed roots) versus a trusted env/existing absolute root (kept usable)

plugin name that is an absolute path (/etc/passwd), contains '..' or '\', or is empty/non-string

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public server API PluginFileManagerServer.uploadFile accepts a documentRoot option that replaces the cached storage's options.documentRoot and then writes through the same multer destination; no allowed-root check is applied to that option.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix only validates a documentRoot submitted by the storages HTTP action; this option is passed by in-process code (e.g. plugin install), so it looks trusted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, file 1 hop from the landing point (server.ts -> storages/local.ts)

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: packageName rows are written by the enable flow, which the fix now validates, so the DB value is assumed to be already safe.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (core/server), ~2 directories from the pm resource action

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PluginManager.create resolves packages/plugins/<name> and, with forceRecreate, rm -rf's it before parseName (i.e. before the new name check) is ever called.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: `pm create` is a developer CLI scaffolding command, not an HTTP action, so it is outside the reachable API surface.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the parseName fix, 90 lines above it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second local-storage helper (e.g. a move/temp-file or thumbnail path) that resolves a record-derived path without the new normalise+containment pair
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getFileStream/copy/delete are written as near-copies of each other in this file, so a maintainer adding one more fs operation would naturally copy the unchecked shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getLocalPluginDir joins a caller-supplied basename into the local packages path with no assertSafePluginPackageName, unlike its siblings getStoragePluginDir (:95-99) and getNodeModulesPluginDir (:113-116)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The safe wrapper resolveSafeChildPath already exists in this file, so a maintainer hardening the plugin-name surface could plausibly add another name->path helper and forget the guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CLI command that rewrites attachment path/filename on disk using the storage config, without going through the write-destination check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is an existing maintenance command over the same storages/attachments records and the same local storage helpers.

O9_family: path traversal leading to arbitrary file write (CWE-73/CWE-434) chained with inclusion of functionality from an untrusted path (CWE-829)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add resolveSafePath to the multer destination and reject '../' in storage.path, treating documentRoot as trusted config - which still lets a stored uploadFile(documentRoot) write anywhere and leaves the plugin-name include open.
